Class MaximumEntropyProductionEngine

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.core.engine.AbstractSimulationEngine
org.ether.society.engines.tier1.MaximumEntropyProductionEngine
All Implemented Interfaces:
SimulationEngineModule
public class MaximumEntropyProductionEngine extends AbstractSimulationEngine
Maximum Entropy Production Principle (MEPP) & Planetary Heat Engine.

Formalizes Axel Kleidon's non-equilibrium planetary thermodynamics (Kleidon 2010, 2012, 2016, Thermodynamic Foundations of the Earth System, Cambridge University Press; Paltridge 1975, Q.J.R. Meteorol. Soc.):

Models Earth's coupled climate, hydrological cycle, and wind circulation as a macroscopic planetary Carnot heat engine operating at its maximum thermodynamic power output (MEP state):

  1. Planetary Carnot Thermodynamic Efficiency (\(\eta_{\text{carnot}}\)): \[ \eta_{\text{carnot}} = \frac{T_s - T_e}{T_s} \approx \frac{288.15 - 255.0}{288.15} \approx 0.115 \quad (11.5\%) \]
  2. Maximum Kinetic Power of the Atmospheric Circulation: \[ G_{\text{ke}} = \frac{1}{4} \eta_{\text{carnot}} \cdot I_{\text{net}} \approx 2.5\text{--}3.5\text{ W/m}^2 \]
  3. Equilibrium Hydrological Evapo-Precipitation: Partitions net surface solar irradiance \(R_n\) into latent heat flux \(\lambda E\) and sensible heat \(H\): \[ \lambda E = \left(\frac{\Delta}{\Delta + \gamma}\right) R_n, \quad P_{\text{precip}} = E = \frac{\lambda E}{\lambda_v} \] where \(\lambda_v \approx 2.45 \times 10^6\text{ J/kg}\) is the latent heat of vaporization of water.
  4. Thermodynamic Limit on Renewable Wind Power Extraction (Kleidon & Miller 2011): Wind turbines cannot extract more than \(\approx 1.0\text{--}1.5\text{ W/m}^2\) of continuous kinetic power without damping atmospheric pressure gradients and collapsing local wind generation.

    calculateCarnotEfficiency(double surfaceTempKelvin)
    Calculates the planetary Carnot thermodynamic efficiency: \[ \eta_{\text{carnot}} = \max\left(0, \frac{T_{\text{surf}} - T_e}{T_{\text{surf}}}\right) \]
    static double
    calculateEquilibriumPrecipitationMmYr(double surfaceTempC, double netRadWM2)
    Calculates thermodynamic equilibrium precipitation/evaporation in millimeters per year (\(\text{mm/yr}\)): \[ E = \frac{\lambda E}{\lambda_v} = \left(\frac{\Delta}{\Delta + \gamma}\right) \frac{R_n}{\lambda_v} \cdot 3.15576 \times 10^7\text{ s/yr} \]
    static double

    Calculates maximum atmospheric kinetic power generation in Watts per square meter (\(\text{W/m}^2\)): \[ G_{\text{ke}} = \frac{1}{4} \eta_{\text{carnot}} \cdot I_{\text{net}} \]
